channel.description: Find the right tool at the right price.

item.title: 28-Inch Barrel Charcoal Grill with Wood Shelves for $104
item.description: This 28-inch barrel charcoal grill features wood shelves and offers 626 square inches of cooking space. The final price is $104.40 after an extra 10% off the sale price of $115.99, applied at checkout.

item.title: Kamado Joe Big Joe 3 charcoal grill now $2,199 at Sam's Club
item.description: The Kamado Joe Big Joe 3 is a large ceramic charcoal grill designed for outdoor cooking. This deal offers the grill at $2,199, which is notably lower than typical Black Friday pricing of around $2,500.

item.title: Pit Boss Lexington 500 Pellet Smoker at Walmart for $346
item.description: The Pit Boss Lexington 500 is a wood-fired pellet grill with 543 square inches of cooking space. Walmart offers it for $346 with free shipping.

item.title: KingChii 3-Burner Propane Griddle Drops to $174.73 at Walmart
item.description: This KingChii 3-burner propane griddle features a 27-inch flat top cooking surface, ideal for camping, tailgating, and backyard parties. It is currently available at Walmart for $174.73 with free shipping.

item.title: ThermoPro TP08 Dual Probe Wireless Meat Thermometer for $18.58 at Walmart
item.description: The ThermoPro TP08 is a wireless remote cooking thermometer with dual probes, designed for use with BBQ smokers, grills, and ovens. It monitors food temperature from up to 300 feet away. This deal offers it at $18.58 at Walmart.com.

item.title: Weber Genesis C-435S Gas Grill at Costco for $899.97
item.description: The Weber Genesis C-435S is a four-burner gas grill with a side burner and stainless steel cooking grates. Costco is offering it at a clearance price of $899.97, with availability varying by store.

item.title: Char-Griller 2-Burner Combo Grill and Smoker for $319.99
item.description: This Char-Griller grill combines propane gas and charcoal in one unit, offering 24,000 BTUs and 870 square inches of cooking space. It functions as a grill and smoker, and is available for $319.99.

item.title: WORX Nitro Hydroshot Plus Pressure Washer Drops to $119.99 at Lowe's
item.description: The WORX Nitro Hydroshot Plus is a cordless pressure washer delivering 710 PSI and 1 GPM with brushless motor and hot water capability. Lowe's offers it at $119.99 with free shipping, including a 4 Ah battery and charger.

item.title: Cuisinart 36" Gas Griddle Cover for $14.60 at Menard's
item.description: This Cuisinart cover is designed to fit 36-inch 4-burner gas griddles, offering protection from the elements. Menard's sells it for $14.60, with free ship-to-store and an 11% rebate in store credit.

item.title: WORKPRO 20-in-1 Electric Screwdriver Drops to $13.99
item.description: This compact electric screwdriver includes 20 S2 steel bits and a magnetizer, powered by a 3.6V motor. Prime members can get it for $13.99 after a 50% discount, down from $27.99, with free shipping.

item.title: Pit Boss Grill Cleaning Brush Drops to $8.99
item.description: This nylon cleaning brush is designed for use on grills and smokers, helping to remove residue and debris from cooking surfaces. The brush is currently available for $8.99 with free shipping for Prime members.

item.title: R.W.FLAME 4-Burner Stainless Steel Gas Grill with Side Burner for $279.99
item.description: This R.W.FLAME grill features four main burners and a side burner, delivering 42,000 BTU of cooking power. It is constructed with premium 304 stainless steel and runs on liquid propane. Available at Wayfair for $279.99.

item.title: Crocodile Cloth Hand & Tool Wipes Drop to $13.49 at Amazon
item.description: These wipes are designed to remove grease and grime from hands and tools. The 100-count pack is available for $13.49 after a $10 discount at checkout, down from the original price of $23.49. Shipping is free with Prime or on orders over $35.

item.title: Vansoet 400W Car Power Inverter with USB-C and AC Outlets for $20.98
item.description: The Vansoet 400W Car Power Inverter converts 12V DC to 110V AC, featuring a 30W USB-C PD port, two USB-A ports, and two AC outlets. It is available for $20.98 with promo code FET59ZY8, plus free shipping with Prime or orders over $35.

item.title: Kobalt 24V Trimmer and Blower Combo Kit for $99 at Lowe's
item.description: This combo kit from Kobalt includes a 12-inch brushless string trimmer/edger and a leaf blower, along with a 3.0-Ah battery and charger. The kit is available for $99 with free shipping.

item.title: Ring Wired Video Doorbell with Chime drops to $34.99 at Best Buy
item.description: Best Buy is offering the Ring Wired Video Doorbell with Chime (2nd Generation) for $34.99 with free shipping for My Best Buy members. This wired video doorbell provides 1080p HD video, two-way talk, and motion alerts, and the chime is included.

item.title: Stanley Modular Rolling Toolbox for $79.92
item.description: This Stanley modular rolling toolbox features a one-handed connect and release quick-release stacking latch, a slide and lock mechanism to keep tools secure, and a durable front for daily use. The deal price is $79.92.

item.title: Traeger Pro 34 Pellet Grill with Cover for $469.98
item.description: The Traeger Pro 34 is a wood pellet grill with a large cooking area, suitable for outdoor cooking. This deal includes the grill cover at a total price of $469.98.

item.title: Kohler PureWash E750 Bidet Seat with Remote, Warm Water, Dryer for $262
item.description: The Kohler PureWash E750 is an elongated electric bidet toilet seat with a remote control, offering warm water and a dryer. Available at Wayfair for $262.32 with free shipping.

item.title: Segway Navimow i206 AWD Robot Mower Drops to $899
item.description: The Segway Navimow i206 AWD is a wire-free robotic lawn mower designed for lawns up to 0.15 acre. It is currently on sale for $899 with free shipping.

item.title: WORX 20V Cordless Pruning Saw Bare Tool Drops to $59
item.description: The WORX WG324.9 is a 20V cordless pruning saw with a 5-inch bar, designed for trimming branches and small cuts. This deal is for the bare tool only, priced at $59, which is significantly lower than the $126.06 price of the kit version that includes a battery and charger.

item.title: Worx 40V Cordless String Trimmer with 2 Batteries for $119.99
item.description: The Worx WG183 is a 40V cordless string trimmer with a 13-inch cutting width and auto-feed dual-exit head. This package includes two 2.0Ah batteries and a charger. It is available for $119.99.

item.title: Tuyluxe 2700K Solar Lanterns 2-Pack for $14.95
item.description: This deal offers a 2-pack of Tuyluxe solar lanterns with 2700K warm light and IP65 waterproof rating. Use promo code Y9R4IEZG at checkout to get the price down to $14.95.

item.title: Amazon Labor Day Sale: Chainsaws Up to 52% Off
item.description: Cordless, gas, mini, and pole saws from brands like Greenworks and Ego are discounted for trimming trees, clearing limbs, and preparing firewood. The sale offers savings up to 52% on select models.

item.title: Pit Boss Smoker Cleaner Grill Tool Drops to $7.30 at Amazon
item.description: The Pit Boss 67290 Smoker Cleaner Grill Tool is a handy accessory for cleaning grills and smokers. It is currently available for $7.30 at Amazon, with free shipping for Prime members or on orders over $35.

item.title: Ironkoi 120-Piece Drywall Anchor Kit for $5 at Amazon
item.description: This kit includes 120 self-drilling drywall anchors and screws, each rated to hold up to 75 pounds. The anchors are made from nylon and glass fibers for durability. The deal is available for $5 after applying a coupon code at Amazon.

item.title: DREAME N10 Carpet Cleaner Drops to $49.99 with Code
item.description: The DREAME N10 is a carpet cleaning machine designed for home use. This deal brings the price down to $49.99 after applying a $100 discount at checkout, with free shipping included.

item.title: Charcoal Grill and Offset Smoker Combo for $209 with Free Ship to Store
item.description: This charcoal barrel grill and offset smoker combination offers 1,235 total square inches of cooking space. It includes a side fire box attachment for Texas-style offset smoking and features dual damper controls. The deal price is $209 with free ship to store.

item.title: Navimow X430 robotic mower on sale for $2,249
item.description: The Navimow X430 is a robotic lawn mower designed for automated grass cutting. This Labor Day promotion offers the mower at $2,249, a discount from its regular price.

item.title: Citrusafe BBQ Grill Scrubber with 3 Pads for $5.97
item.description: This grill scrubber comes with a handle and three heavy-duty blue nylon pads. The deal is available for $5.97 with free shipping for Walmart+ members or with pickup where available.
